prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” interior painting company for all homeowners — the right choice depends on your neighborhood, project size, budget, timing and style needs. I can help you find the best fit. Quick guidance to get you there:

1) Tell me: where in St. Louis (zip or neighborhood) and what kind of job (single room, whole house, ceilings & trim, repair + drywall, timeline, budget)?

2) Shortlist sources to search and verify
- Google / Yelp / Angi / Houzz for recent reviews and photos
- Better Business Bureau for complaints and ratings
- Ask neighbors or local Facebook groups for personal referrals

3) National franchises often available in St. Louis (good starting points)
- CertaPro Painters
- Five Star Painting
- WOW 1 Day Painting
(These have systems, insurance and reviews; also consider strong local independent shops.)

4) How to vet bids (get at least 3)
- Written estimate with line items (prep, materials, number of coats, trim/baseboard, doors)
- Proof of insurance and worker coverage
- Timeline and start/finish dates
- Warranty/guarantee on labor and paint
- References and photos of similar completed jobs
- Ask about the paint brands and sheen, color consultation, and sample patches

5) Questions to ask a contractor
- Are you licensed and insured?
- Who will do the work — employees or subs?
- How many coats and what primer will you use?
- How do you handle repairs, caulking and sanding?
- What’s included in cleanup and final walk-through?

6) Ballpark pricing (very general)
- One room (small bedroom): $300–900
- Whole interior (average 2,000 sq ft): $4,000–12,000
- Per sq ft: roughly $1.50–$4.00 depending on prep, trim, ceilings and paint quality
(Ask contractors for detailed quotes — costs vary a lot.)

If you want, give me your zip code or exact neighborhood and the job details and I’ll suggest 3–5 well-reviewed companies in your area and what to ask each of them.
